notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). It turns a list of target compound concentrations, volumes, a solvent/diluent stage scheme and a solubility limit into a multi-tube serial-dilution protocol, a stock-weighing summary, a material list and a 96-well plate layout, all of which can be exported for the bench. Data used in the run: none. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
